title: Quiet money (batch 4): Gulf AI/surveillance capital, crypto's quiet controllers, and political kingmakers
source: Public record: UAE state/company structures (G42, ADQ, IHC, Royal Group, MGX); Tether ownership + reserves reporting; NYAG DCG/Genesis settlement; FEC/OpenSecrets; company filings. Catalog layer (#242 batch 4). Structural overlay; person nodes carry dossiers. FOCUS: quiet foreign + crypto + political money shaping AI/surveillance/policy. HONESTY: control/holdings/donations = fact; influence/intent graded; no cabal imputed.

edges.notes: Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed - UAE National Security Advisor + brother of the president - chairs G42, the Abu Dhabi AI champion (Microsoft's $1.5B partner; ex-Huawei/China ties unwound under US pressure). The quiet nexus of Gulf AI + intelligence + capital (fact).

Tahnoon-linked MGX (with Mubadala + G42) is a ~$100B AI-investment fund - a participant in the OpenAI/Stargate compute financing orbit - projecting Gulf capital into the AI-infrastructure core (fact).
Tahnoon chairs International Holding Company (IHC) - Abu Dhabi's largest listed conglomerate (a meteoric ~$200B+ market cap) - the corporate vehicle of the Royal Group empire (fact).
Tahnoon chairs ADQ, one of Abu Dhabi's three sovereign wealth funds - completing his control of an AI + capital + national-security stack unusual in its concentration (fact).
Royal Group is Tahnoon's private conglomerate umbrella (IHC, G42-adjacent) - the family holding structure (fact).

As UAE National Security Advisor + spymaster, Tahnoon fuses state intelligence with the AI/data + capital empire he controls - the archetype of state-capital-surveillance fusion (fact of roles; fusion = interpretation).
MGX is among the Gulf vehicles financing OpenAI/Stargate-scale compute - wiring Tahnoon's capital to the AI-bubble core (fact of participation; exact terms evolving).
Microsoft's $1.5B G42 investment (2024) came with a US-brokered condition that G42 divest Chinese tech - the geopolitics of Gulf AI alignment (fact).

Giancarlo Devasini - the quiet Italian ex-plastic-surgeon who is Tether's largest owner + chairman (moved to El Salvador) - effectively controls the ~$140B+ stablecoin issuer whose profits rival the biggest banks, with famously opaque governance (fact).
Paolo Ardoino - Tether CEO + public face - runs the operation Devasini controls; increasingly a geopolitical actor (Bitcoin/AI/compute + El Salvador ties) (fact).

Tether's reserves make it one of the largest holders of US Treasury bills (~$100B+) - a private, lightly-regulated offshore issuer now systemically entangled with US debt markets (fact; the core stablecoin-Treasury-rail concern).
Tether plows profits into Bitcoin + gold + compute/AI - turning stablecoin seigniorage into a sovereign-like balance sheet (fact).
Barry Silbert founded + leads Digital Currency Group (DCG) - the crypto conglomerate behind Grayscale + Genesis; lower-profile than the exchange founders but structurally central (fact).
DCG owns Grayscale (GBTC) - the vehicle that channeled institutional Bitcoin exposure (and whose discount fed the 2022 contagion) (fact).
DCG owned Genesis (lending), whose 2022-23 collapse (post-FTX) triggered the Gemini Earn dispute + a 2024 NYAG settlement (~$2B) alleging fraud - the quiet-conglomerate risk laid bare (fact).

Miriam Adelson - controlling shareholder of Las Vegas Sands (after Sheldon Adelson's death) - deploys the casino fortune as the single largest Republican + pro-Israel donor (Preserve America PAC), quietly decisive in recent cycles (fact).
Adelson is a leading funder of pro-Israel + Netanyahu-aligned causes (Israel Hayom newspaper; US pro-Israel politics) - money as foreign-policy influence (fact).

Tim Dunn - Midland oilman (CrownQuest) - the quiet financier who reshaped Texas politics toward Christian-nationalist hard-right via the Defend Texas Liberty / Texans-for-Fiscal-Responsibility machine (fact).
Dunn (with the Wilks brothers) bankrolled Defend Texas Liberty - the PAC that drove Texas GOP primaries hard-right; a case study in a single quiet donor capturing a state party (fact).
Dunn + the Wilks brothers are the co-funders of the Texas hard-right infrastructure - wiring batch-4 to batch-3 quiet money (fact of co-funding).
Harold Hamm - founder of Continental Resources (shale pioneer; took it private 2022) - a quiet energy kingmaker + top Trump energy-policy donor/advisor ('drill baby drill') (fact).
Hamm's family controls Continental after the 2022 take-private - concentrating a major US shale producer + political-energy influence in private hands (fact).
